newsitem.title: GERMANY: IVG sees growth from logistics.
newsitem.headline: IVG sees growth from logistics.

text.p: IVG Holding AG said on Monday its sales rose to 383.6 million marks and pre-tax profit rose to 42.5 million marks in the first half of 1997, driven by growth in the logistics sector.
Year-earlier figures were 255.7 million marks and 38.4 million marks, respectively.
The company said it expects full-year profit to rise 10 percent.
IVG's purchase of petrol-delivery firm Talis GmbH helped logistics sales to more than double to 208.8 million marks. The company is also expanding into chemicals transport.
In real estate, its second major business sector, rental income and sales held steady despite a difficult market.
